name: Draw Me Close To You
overview: The theme of drawing close to God reveals His faithful presence and tender care for His people. God promises unwavering companionship and protection, as seen in His assurance to Joshua that He will never forsake him, just as He was with Moses. The psalmist highlights that God is near to those with broken and contrite hearts, offering refuge under His wings and a shield of truth. Furthermore, God gently leads and carries His flock, demonstrating a compassionate shepherd’s care for those who trust and call upon Him in sincerity.
